dedupe_keys.name: dataset for publication search space representation and reduction methods to enhance multi objective water supply monitoring design

description: Felix Bode at the University of Stuttgart publishes the data supporting a groundwater-monitoring design benchmark. The November 2018 Zenodo deposit provides data.zip under CC BY 4.0. The describing Water Resources Research paper explicitly links this DOI and identifies the U_Protect case, which abstracts an urban drinking-water well catchment with restricted monitoring locations and heterogeneous hydraulic conductivity. Its objectives compare contamination-detection probability, early-warning time and cost. These data can support replication of search-space reduction experiments and comparisons of monitoring-network optimisation within water-supply simulations. The archive layout, internal formats, geographical identity and observation period remain unknown from the repository summary. The benchmark represents a constructed test problem, not a current operational monitoring network. No related catalogue record explicitly covers U_Protect. The paper metadata and data-availability link were checked, while the archive was not downloaded.
